mostWorthwhile.text: Building the gravity and acceleration organs was most worthwhile: the planned comparison distinguishes head tilt and starting movement from steady motion.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the two organ types to their nerves took separate, fairly predictable steps; the intermediate pathway pictures added less explanation than the sensor and reflex examples.

surprise.text: The final picture links head rotation to eyes moving in the opposite direction, while also showing posture adjustments.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the sequential nerve connections were largely dictated by the available pieces.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting sensor mechanics to a visible reflex was interesting, although the intermediate assembly was predictable.
